name: Nakatane (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakatane town emblem in navy: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Nakatane, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 March 1967.

features.role: Nakatane town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character with a vertical bar
